'''Cera Vixe''' was the daughter of [[Rae Vixe]], and the sister of [[Boe Vixe]]. She was in love with [[Vee Naaq]], but her father had banned her from seeing her love. In response, Naaq hired a group of individuals to "rescue" Vixe from her father.<ref name="FP" />
